buildCommand: if [ -z "$VERCEL_ENV" ] || [ -z "$VERCEL" ]; then echo '[preview-verify] FAIL: VERCEL_ENV/VERCEL not set, tests would not run' >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "preview" ]; then echo '[preview-verify] START test:maintenance'; npm run test:maintenance || { echo '[preview-verify] FAIL: test:maintenance' >&2; exit 1; }; echo '[preview-verify] PASSED test:maintenance'; npm run build; else echo "[preview-verify] VERCEL_ENV=$VERCEL_ENV: tests skipped, build only"; npm run build; fi
